cards.prompt: RF-DETR is built on top of which vision transformer backbone?
Which two dataset formats can RF-DETR be trained on?
Name the vision tasks RF-DETR supports.
cards.answer: Object detection, segmentation, and keypoint detection.

cards.prompt: In a COCO-format dataset, every split folder (train, valid, test) holds its images plus a file named ____.
Which is NOT a top-level key of a COCO annotation JSON?
cards.answer: 'weights' is not a COCO key; the keys are info, licenses, images, categories, annotations.

cards.prompt: In a COCO annotation entry, which two fields link a box to its image and its class?
A COCO annotation has bbox [100, 150, 200, 180] and area 36000. How does area relate to bbox?
cards.answer: Area is width x height of the box: 200 x 180 = 36000.

cards.prompt: In the COCO layout, each of train, valid and test has its own annotations JSON file.
cards.answer: Fact: each split folder contains its own _annotations.coco.json.
